question: Jatin Goswami, who was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship, is a renowned dancer of the _________ dance style.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jatin Goswami** is a renowned dancer known for his contributions to the **Sattriya** dance form.
 
• **Sattriya** is one of the eight principal classical Indian dance traditions.
 
• It originated in the **state of Assam**.
 
• The dance form is attributed to the 15th-century Vaishnavite saint and scholar **Sankardev**.
 
• **Sattriya** dance is traditionally performed in **Sattras** (Assamese monasteries).
 
• The dance form includes a repertoire of **mythological stories** and **epic narratives**.
 
• **Jatin Goswami** has played a significant role in popularizing and preserving **Sattriya** dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kathak**__

 __
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight classical dance forms of India.
 
• It originated in **Northern India** and is known for its intricate footwork and spins.
 
• It is traditionally performed by **wandering storytellers** called Kathakars.
 
 
 
• **Chhau**__
 __
 
• **Chhau** is a traditional martial dance form.
 
• It is prevalent in the **eastern Indian states** of West Bengal, Jharkhand, and Odisha.
 
• The dance form incorporates elements of **martial arts** and **folk traditions**.
 
 
 
• **Manipuri**__
 
 
• **Manipuri** is one of the major classical dance forms of India.
 
• It originated in the northeastern state of **Manipur**.
 
• The dance form is known for its **graceful movements** and **devotional themes**.
